prompt: What was the name of the sculptor who created the war memorial, a twenty-two-and-a-half-foot statue of bronze and granite depicting a Canadian soldier in battle dress, in Brockville, Ontario, that was unveiled in 1924?
answer: The sculptor was **Nicholas Pirotton**, a Belgian-born sculptor who had immigrated to Canada. The bronze figure was cast by the **Allis-Chalmers Company of Toronto**, while the granite memorial was built by the **McIntosh Granite Company**.
